items.title: DeepSeek Pushes Out Updated AI Model It Says Is Faster, Leaner
items.summary:
The rapid pace of DeepSeek's new launches underscores the intensifying contest between China's open-weight models and the proprietary models of their US counterparts, which are top performers, but with far higher costs.

DeepSeek's latest iteration delivers "substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks," the Hangzhou-based startup said in its technical report on Hugging Face, the online platform for AI models, data sets and apps. [...] Saturday's model update was preceded by the slimmed down V4.1-Flash AI system, unveiled early in September. DeepSeek offered it at such a steep discount that shares of rivals such as MiniMax Group Inc., Z.ai and even the giant Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., which is driving its Qwen models, plummeted on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

The latest update seeks to be a stronger, faster and more compact version of its predecessor. [...] DeepSeek disclosed benchmarking scores for its latest update on X. On Humanity's Last Exam, the revised model scored 36.8 to 42.6, an improvement on V4.1-Flash, which scored 36.8 to 39.1. HLE, as it's known, measures how AI models perform on thousands of questions in math, sciences and humanities.

items.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems | TechCrunch
items.summary:
The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing services and products developed by Chinese AI startup DeepSeek and remove them from government IT systems over national security concerns tied to the Chinese AI startup’s operations in China, according to the Department of Homeland Security. The order goes beyond banning DeepSeek’s own product, and covers third-party products and services built using DeepSeek technology, though agencies can request exceptions. [...] The DHS raised concerns about DeepSeek’s handling of user data, warning that sensitive information from U.S. government users could potentially be accessible to Chinese authorities under Chinese law, the order said.

The move comes amid intensifying tech competition in AI between the U.S. and China. The Chinese AI model challenges its U.S. rivals, including OpenAI and Meta, with low-cost open-weight models. [...] In addition, OpenAI and Anthropic have separately raised concerns about DeepSeek’s alleged use of model distillation, a technique that uses outputs from one AI model to train another. Earlier this year, OpenAI told U.S. lawmakers it had observed suspected attempts by DeepSeek to distill its models, while Anthropic said it had identified unauthorized attempts by DeepSeek and other Chinese AI labs to collect outputs from Claude.

items.title: US orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems, citing national security risks | South China Morning Post
items.summary:
Citing national security concerns, the US government has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and any third-party services developed using the Chinese artificial intelligence model from their information systems.

In a notice made public on Monday, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also barred agencies from acquiring DeepSeek products and services, including those developed by affiliated entities.

items.title: DeepSeek’s AI Agent Platform Reaches 1.54 Million Daily Active Users - Bloomberg
items.summary:
# DeepSeek’s AI Agent Platform Hits 1.54 Million Daily Users

DeepSeek, the Chinese AI disruptor, released striking adoption numbers for its AI agent infrastructure as it continues to challenge Anthropic PBC and OpenAI with an entire swath of applications built around open-source AI technologies. [...] On Sunday, the Hangzhou-headquartered startup disclosed on X that DeepSeek Harness, its open-source agent application, had reached 1.54 million daily active users by November 4, less than three months after its August 13 debut. Daily users were at about 271,000 at the end of September, right after it released a desktop version of the app, based on the number of users connecting to its own servers.

items.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems
items.summary:
DeepSeek's AI models "present multiple threat vectors," the latest DHS order states, citing concerns over potential access to sensitive data by Chinese authorities and potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

The agency also warned that using DeepSeek's AI models could result in sensitive U.S. government data being transferred to China, potentially providing intelligence on American citizens and government programs. [...] Since DeepSeek burst onto the scene at the start of 2025, several U.S. government agencies have imposed various restrictions.

Congress restricted the use of DeepSeek in intelligence community systems in December 2025. Earlier that year in March, U.S. Commerce Department bureaus told staff DeepSeek was banned on government devices, Reuters reported at the time. The Defense Information Systems Agency moved to block access to DeepSeek models in January 2025, according to reports from Bloomberg. [...] The Trump administration banned Chinese AI startup DeepSeek from civilian U.S. government agencies, citing security concerns.

The Department of Homeland Security on Monday made public the order requiring federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek-related technology from their IT systems and barring them from procuring DeepSeek products and services. The ban applies to federal civilian agency IT systems, including third-party products and services developed using the company's technology.

args.content:
### Tin tức mới nhất về OpenAI trong tuần này

1. **OpenAI ra mắt GPT-4.5**: OpenAI đã công bố phiên bản mới của mô hình ngôn ngữ GPT-4.5, với nhiều cải tiến về khả năng hiểu và tạo ngôn ngữ tự nhiên.

2. **Hợp tác với Microsoft**: OpenAI đã mở rộng quan hệ đối tác với Microsoft, tích hợp công nghệ AI vào các sản phẩm của họ, bao gồm Office và Azure.

3. **Chính sách bảo mật dữ liệu**: OpenAI đã công bố các biện pháp mới để bảo vệ dữ liệu người dùng, nhấn mạnh cam kết của họ đối với quyền riêng tư và bảo mật.

4. **Nghiên cứu AI có trách nhiệm**: OpenAI đã công bố một báo cáo mới về nghiên cứu AI có trách nhiệm, nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của việc phát triển công nghệ AI một cách an toàn và có đạo đức.

5. **Sự kiện hội thảo**: OpenAI đã tổ chức một hội thảo trực tuyến về ứng dụng của AI trong giáo dục, thu hút sự tham gia của nhiều chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực này.
